explanation: Jacobsthal-type problem: maxY(x) is the largest y such that [1, y] can be covered by one residue class mod each prime p ≤ x. The sSup is over a bounded, downward-closed set containing 0, so it is well defined. The question asks for a lower bound strictly beating x·log x·logloglog x/loglog x (Ford–Green–Konyagin–Maynard–Tao). That matches Green's remark that any improvement would be significant. The statement is faithful.
